included_resources.ec2: one Linux shared-tenancy t3.large running for 730 hours

components.name: EC2 t3.large Linux On-Demand
components.source_note: Public AWS list-price index; catalog date 2026-11-22, not an AWS Calculator quote.

components.name: Encrypted gp3 root and data volumes
components.source_note: Mumbai public Price List rate, checked 2026-11-03; baseline gp3 performance included.

components.name: One attached public IPv4 address
components.source_note: AWS published in-use public IPv4 hourly rate, accessed 2026-11-28; the attached Elastic IP is the one address counted.

assumptions: one shared Linux t3.large On-Demand instance, 100% utilization, 730 hours/month
64 GiB gp3 EBS per instance, baseline IOPS and throughput, no snapshots
one in-use public IPv4 address and zero idle addresses
one public Route 53 hosted zone, no DNS query volume entered
pricing_calculator_cross_check.rounding_note: The calculator rounds displayed components before summing ($75.40); this script sums unrounded list-price inputs before currency rounding ($75.39). The one-cent difference is display rounding.
pricing_calculator_cross_check.persistence: Estimate was reviewed in the public calculator; it was not exported, shared, or attached to an AWS account. No AWS resources were provisioned.

exclusions: S3 object storage, requests, retrieval and transfer
CloudWatch log ingestion, retention, metrics, alarms and notifications
domain registration, taxes, support and account-specific credits or discounts
CPU capacity/performance beyond the t3.large Standard-mode baseline
limitations: Regional rates were cross-checked against the AWS Pricing Calculator on 2026-11-28; re-check live prices, workload and region before budget approval because rates and usage assumptions can change.
The estimate is an always-on fixed-resource floor, not an all-in bill or production capacity estimate.
Terraform configures t3.large CPU credit mode as Standard to avoid unlimited surplus-credit charges; sustained load beyond its documented baseline can constrain performance.
Actual AWS provisioning and an account-specific AWS plan were not authorized or performed.
